report.answer: The structural map engine lives in internal/mapengine/ (types.go, goast.go, treesitter.go, regex.go). Engine selection is done by mapAuto() in types.go: `.go` files use GoASTMapper (go/ast, falls back to regex on error); `.ts .tsx .js .jsx .py .rs` use TreeSitterMapper (gotreesitter grammars, via mapTreeSitterWithFallback which falls back to regex on unsupported/failed parse); everything else uses RegexMapper. Users can override via Options.Engine (EngineGoAST/EngineTreeSitter/EngineRegex) exposed as the CLI `--map-engine` flag, handled in the top-level Map() dispatcher.

verified.summary: mapAuto() dispatches by file extension: .go -> GoASTMapper w/ regex fallback; .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx/.py/.rs -> TreeSitterMapper w/ regex fallback; default -> RegexMapper
